newsitem.title: USA: US West Media to buy Michigan cable systems.
newsitem.headline: US West Media to buy Michigan cable systems.

text.p: US West Media Group said on Tuesday it would acquire cable systems in Michigan from Booth American Co for $75 million in stock and debt.
The deal, structured as a tax-free merger, will consist of $50 million in US West Inc preferred stock and $25 million in assumed debt, the company said.

The cable systems, located in Birmingham, Bloomfield and Summit-Leoni, serve about 40,000 Michigan households. The company said they are contiguous to Continental Cablevision systems serving 345,000 Michigan households.
Continental was merged into US West last month. The company said the Michigan expansion will lead to improved operational efficiencies.
"This acquisition enhances our cluster in Michigan with high-quality systems of unusually high penetrations and revenues-per-customer," said Chuck Lillis, president and CEO of US West Media Group.
